changelog:
- Initial release of gougoubi-premarket-search.
- Fuzzy keyword search for Pre-Market predictions on ggb.ai by title or topic, supporting cross-lingual queries.
- No authentication required; public read-only endpoint.
- Returns concise prediction results with localization and ranking consistent with the ggb.ai trending feed.
- Intended as a discovery tool before publishing, commenting, liking, or saving predictions to prevent duplicates and surface related content.
